title: CetiRun Helm Chart Values Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating CetiRun agent chart values

cetiadmin.description: Operator-prepared binding. Final templates require the ordinary Hermes runtime contribution; these values do not grant RBAC.

sandboxWorkload.description: Internal protected Sandbox render plan; not an execution authorization

ingressMTLS.description: Internal common-executor managed Envoy endpoint; absent for ordinary ingress

egressSNI.description: Internal compiler-owned observed-SNI capture; never a user policy override

managedInitContainers.description: Exact managed Envoy and trusted capture initializer prefix

skillsMode.description: Internal native empty-selection source; omitted for the existing skills PVC path

trustedProxyIPs.description: Compiler-selected ingress IPs or registered Pod CIDRs; not tenant proxy trust

global.description: Shared release coordinates inherited from an umbrella chart

registry.description: Optional registry hostname override for all CetiRun images

version.description: Shared image and component version; empty defaults to Chart appVersion

agentType.description: Agent framework to run in this instance

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. 0 when suspended, 1 for normal operation.

tag.description: Image tag (defaults to Chart appVersion if not set)

digest.description: Image digest for pinning (e.g. sha256:abc123...). When set, the image reference becomes repository:tag@digest.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries

nameOverride.description: String to override the default name

fullnameOverride.description: String to override the default fullname

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

name.description: The name of the service account to use (BYO). If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

role.description: Bind service account to a built-in Kubernetes ClusterRole. Options: '' (none), 'view' (read-only), 'cluster-admin' (full access). Only applies when create is true and name is not set.

automountToken.description: Explicitly control the default Kubernetes API token mount. Null preserves historical behavior.

azureWorkloadIdentity.description: Azure Workload Identity configuration. Requires AKS cluster with OIDC issuer and workload identity enabled, plus a federated credential linking the managed identity to this service account.

clientId.description: Client ID of the User-Assigned Managed Identity

agentIdentity.description: Operator-owned Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Broker integration

aiGateway.description: Operator-owned platform AI Gateway access for the Agent's model traffic

keySecretName.description: Secret in the release namespace holding the Agent's virtual key

keySecretKey.description: Key within the virtual key Secret

models.description: Models the Gateway offers the Agent

visionModels.description: Ids of the models in models that accept images

keyEnv.description: Environment variable that carries the Agent's key to Hermes' Gateway provider

masterKeyId.description: Identifies the proxy's master key; a new value restarts the proxy

signInGeneration.description: Generation of the GitHub Copilot sign-in the Agent uses; a new value restarts the proxy

responsesModels.description: Copilot models served only through the Responses API

nodePort.description: NodePort (only used when service.type is NodePort)

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the container

storageClass.description: Storage class name (default uses Azure Disk on AKS; empty uses the cluster default)

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC to use (if set, StatefulSet will use this instead of creating new PVCs)

tag.description: Image tag (defaults to Chart appVersion if not set)

portalSignIn.description: Sign the owner in to the Control UI with their Portal sign-in (OpenClaw trusted-proxy mode)

enabled.description: Run openclaw doctor --fix on pod start

azureDevOps.description: Azure DevOps git credential helper configuration

enabled.description: Enable Azure DevOps git credential helper (uses az CLI for tokens)

tag.description: Image tag (defaults to Chart appVersion if not set)

HERMES_WEBAPP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Operator-owned external Webapp URL including its instance prefix

user.description: User identity, typically populated by the operator from Agent CR spec.user. Templates USER.md in the ConfigMap.

alias.description: User's short alias. Used as part of the namespace name (cetirun-<alias>) and access URL.

displayName.description: User's human-friendly display name, shown in USER.md.

team.description: Logical team name, populated by the operator.

role.description: User's role, injected into USER.md. When empty, the Role line is omitted.

description.description: User context lines injected as Notes bullets in USER.md.

baseDomain.description: Base domain for instance access URLs (e.g. example.com).

secrets.description: Secrets configuration for API keys and tokens

existingSecret.description: Use existing secret instead of creating one

telegramTokenFile.description: File path to read Telegram bot token from (alternative to telegramBotToken)

braveApiKey.description: Brave Search API key (enables web search)

perplexityApiKey.description: Perplexity API key (enables AI-synthesized web search)

tailscaleAuthKey.description: Tailscale auth key. Setting this enables Tailscale mesh VPN (no separate toggle).

provider.description: AI Gateway protocol; upstream providers are managed by the platform

model.description: Model name supplied by the operator from spec.model or its deployment default

apiKey.description: Removed direct credentials; use the AI Gateway

apiBase.description: Custom API base URL (uses provider default if empty)

authMode.description: Authentication mode for the model provider (e.g. device-code, token)

shell.description: Absolute path to the shell to launch in ttyd

basePath.description: Base path prefix for ttyd web UI (passed as --base-path flag)

tailscale.description: Tailscale mesh VPN configuration. Enabled when secrets.tailscaleAuthKey is set.

hostname.description: Hostname prefix on the Tailscale network. Each pod appends '-<ordinal>' (up to 7 chars), so the prefix is capped at 56 to stay within the 63-char DNS label limit.

serve.description: Enable tailscale serve to proxy the gateway with Tailscale HTTPS

litellm.description: The removed per-Agent model proxy is unsupported; use the platform AI Gateway.

resources.description: LiteLLM sidecar resource requests and limits

codexModel.description: Model for Codex CLI (routed through LiteLLM sidecar)

provider.description: Model provider: github_copilot, anthropic, or openai

apiKey.description: API key for the provider (not needed for github_copilot)

apiBase.description: API base URL (optional, for custom endpoints)

embeddingApiKey.description: API key for the embedding provider used by memory search. When set together with litellm.enabled, memory search is enabled.

embeddingApiBase.description: Base URL for the embedding provider (optional; omit for default OpenAI endpoint)

embeddingProvider.description: Embedding provider name (e.g. openai, azure, cohere). Used to build the litellm_params model string.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for LiteLLM sidecar

configOverride.description: Override the default LiteLLM config entirely

failureThreshold.description: Null selects 60 for common-executor OpenClaw Sandboxes, otherwise 30; explicit positive integers are preserved

logger.description: Session logger sidecar that tails JSONL files to stdout for Container Insights

enabled.description: Enable the session logger sidecar container

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the logger sidecar

scanInterval.description: Interval (seconds) between scans for new session files

desktop.description: Desktop sidecar configuration. Runs Chrome + noVNC in a separate container. The gateway connects to Chrome via CDP on localhost:18800.

enabled.description: Enable desktop sidecar (Chrome + noVNC via Xvfb)

tag.description: Image tag (defaults to chart appVersion if not set)

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the desktop sidecar

novncPathPrefix.description: noVNC WebSocket path prefix injected by the operator (e.g. 'example-agent/desktop/'). Written into the auto-connect redirect as ?path=<prefix>websockify.

logging.description: Route x11vnc and websockify output to container stderr (visible via kubectl logs). Off by default; enable for troubleshooting.

sidecarScope.description: Istio Sidecar scope configuration. Restricts Envoy service discovery so each user namespace only sees its own services plus shared namespaces, preventing information disclosure via the Envoy admin API.

enabled.description: Enable Istio Sidecar resource for discovery scoping

additionalEgressHosts.description: Additional namespace/host entries beyond auto-included ones. Format: namespace/hostname or namespace/*

istioNamespace.description: Namespace of the Istio control plane (istiod). Acts as the default namespace for the Istio ingress gateway and for mTLS cert-signing egress (port 15012). If istioIngressNamespace is set, it overrides this value for ingress only.

istioIngressNamespace.description: Override namespace for the Istio ingress gateway, when it differs from istioNamespace (e.g., AKS managed Istio uses aks-istio-ingress). Falls back to istioNamespace if empty or unset.

agentIdentityBrokerNamespace.description: Namespace hosting the deployment-level Agent Identity Broker

gatewayNamespace.description: Namespace of the platform AI Gateway, for egress when aiGateway.enabled

gatewayPort.description: Service port of the platform AI Gateway

allowedInternalCIDRs.description: Internal IPs/CIDRs to explicitly allow despite blockedCIDRs. Each entry specifies a CIDR and a list of ports.

ports.description: Ports to allow for this CIDR

blockedCIDRs.description: CIDRs to block from external egress (kube-dns and gateway are allowed via namespace selectors regardless)

skills.description: Shared skills volume configuration. Auto-creates PV/PVC backed by Azure Blob CSI (NFS by default; Fuse/Fuse2 supported). Protocol, secretName, and mountOptions are install-time-only PV settings.

existingClaim.description: Separately owned namespace-local skills PVC; suppresses chart PV/PVC creation

subPath.description: Operator-set Skill Marketplace Team subtree (teams/<team-uid>) of the shared skills claim; only the HOME initializer mounts it, read-only

marketplace.description: Operator-set Skill Marketplace selection of the Agent's Team; set together with subPath

selectionDigest.description: Team selection digest that the HOME initializer waits for

storageClassName.description: StorageClass for the shared skills PV/PVC

protocol.description: Install-time-only Blob CSI protocol. Use fuse2 for HTTPS-only storage accounts. Create a replacement PV/PVC to change it.

secretName.description: Install-time-only namespace-local secret used by Blob Fuse mounts. Create a replacement PV/PVC to change it.

mountOptions.description: Install-time-only static PV mount options. Create a replacement PV/PVC to change them.

resourceGroup.description: Azure resource group containing the storage account

mountPath.description: Optional read-only alias of the common skills view for native Agents (must be absolute)

clawHub.description: ClawHub skill package names (reserved, not yet implemented).

npm.description: npm skill package specs (e.g. "@scope/name" or "@scope/name@1.2.3"). Installed by the init-skills container into the home volume under .cetirun/skills/npm/<sanitized-name>.

npmRegistry.description: npm registry for runtime npm skill installation.

execRestriction.description: Block kubectl exec into openclaw pods. Requires Kubernetes 1.30+.
